entries.1.18.1: सः तु and he, प्रजानाम् to the people, श्रेष्ठैः with the finest, गुणैः qualities, युक्तः endowed, पार्थिवात्मजः the king's son, गुणतः by his virtues, बहिश्चरः moving outside them, प्राणः इव like their very life-breath, प्रियः dear, बभूव became
entries.4.35: श्वोभाविनि that is to take place tomorrow, अभिषेचने in the consecration, अत्र here, यानि यानि whatever, योग्यानि are fitting, तानि those, मङ्गलानि auspicious rites, अद्य today, मे for me, वैदेह्याश्चैव and for Vaidehi, कारय have performed
entries.4.36: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, चिरकालाभिकांक्षितम् longed for through long time, कौसल्या Kausalya, हर्षबाष्पाकुलम् choked with tears of joy, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, रामम् to Rama, अभाषत spoke
entries.4.37: वत्स O dear child, राम O Rama, चिरम् long, जीव live, ते your, परिपन्थिनः adversaries, हताः are destroyed, त्वम् you, श्रिया with royal fortune, युक्तः endowed, मे my, ज्ञातीन् kinsfolk, सुमित्रायाश्च and those of Sumitra, नन्दय gladden
entries.4.38: पुत्रक O dear son, कल्याणे under an auspicious, नक्षत्रे constellation, बत surely, मया by me, जातः असि you were born, येन whereby, त्वया by you, पिता your father, दशरथः Dasharatha, गुणैः by your virtues, आराधितः has been won
entries.4.39: पुत्र O son, पुष्करेक्षणे lotus-eyed, पुरुषे in this man, मे my, यत् which, क्षान्तम् endurance, अमोघम् बत was surely not in vain, या इयम् this very, इक्ष्वाकुराजश्रीः royal fortune of the Ikshvakus, त्वाम् you, संश्रयिष्यति shall attend
entries.4.40: इत्येवम् in this wise, मात्रा by his mother, उक्तः तु addressed, रामः Rama, प्राञ्जलिम् with joined palms, प्रह्वम् bowing, आसीनम् seated, भ्रातरम् his brother, अभिवीक्ष्य having looked upon, स्मयन् इव smiling as it were, अब्रवीत् said
entries.4.41: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, त्वम् you, मया सार्धम् along with me, इमाम् this, वसुंधराम् earth, प्रशाधि rule, इयम् this, श्रीः royal fortune, मे my, द्वितीयम् second, अन्तरात्मानम् very self, त्वाम् to you, उपस्थिता has come
entries.4.42: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, त्वम् you, इष्टान् desired, राज्यफलानि च and the fruits of the kingdom, भोगान् enjoyments, भुक्ष्व enjoy, जीवितम् चापि my life too, राज्यं च and the kingdom, त्वदर्थम् for your sake, अभिकामये do I desire
entries.4.43: इति thus, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, उक्त्वा having spoken, रामः Rama, मातरौ his mothers, अभिवाद्य च and having saluted, सीतां च and Sita, अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave of, स्वम् his own, निवेशनं च and dwelling, ययौ went to
entries.14.63.1: भामिनि O lady, राजवचनम् the king's word, अश्रुत्वा without hearing, कथम् how, गच्छामि shall I go, मन्त्रिणः of the counsellor, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा the king, मन्त्रिणम् to the counsellor, अब्रवीत् said
entries.16.48: रामः Rama, करेणुमातङ्गरथाश्वसंकुलम् thronged with she-elephants and tuskers and chariots and horses, महाजनौघैः with great throngs of people, परिपूर्णचत्वरम् its squares filled, प्रभूतरत्नम् abounding in jewels, बहुपण्यसंचयम् with heaps of merchandise, विमलम् spotless, महापथम् the great highway, ददर्श saw
entries.21.18.1: कैकेय्यासक्तमानसम् his mind bound to Kaikeyi, वृद्धम् aged, कृपणम् wretched, बाल्ये in childishness, स्थितम् sunk, वृद्धभावेन by reason of old age, गर्हितम् contemptible, पितरम् my father, हनिष्ये I shall slay
entries.23.41: राघववंशवर्धनः increaser of the line of Raghu, सः he, बाष्पम् his tears, विमृज्य having wiped, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, असकृत् च and again and again, परिसान्त्व्य having comforted, उवाच said, सौम्य O gentle one, माम् me, पित्रोः of my parents, वचने in the word, व्यवस्थितम् established, निबोध know, एषः this, सत्पथः हि is indeed the path of the good
entries.30.47: ततः then, प्रहृष्टा delighted, प्रतिपूर्णमानसा her heart fulfilled, यशस्विनी the illustrious, मनस्विनी high-minded, अङ्गना lady, भर्तुः of her lord, भाषितम् the speech, अवेक्ष्य having marked, धर्मभृताम् to the upholders of dharma, धनानि wealth, रत्नानि च and jewels, दातुम् to give, प्रचक्रमे set about
entries.35.21: सौम्य O gentle one, नृपते O ruler of men, तत्र thereupon, ते your, जननी mother, क्रुद्धा enraged, मृत्युपाशम् the noose of death, अभीप्सती seeking, ते your, हासम् laughter, जिज्ञासामि I would test, इति thus, चाब्रवीत् and said
entries.35.36: इति thus, सान्त्वैश्च with soothing words, तीक्ष्णैश्च and with sharp, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, सुमन्त्रः तु and Sumantra, राजसंसदि in the royal assembly, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, भूयः again and again, संक्षोभयामास sought to shake
entries.35.37: सा that, देवी queen, न एव क्षुभ्यते was not shaken at all, न च परिदूयते स्म nor did she grieve, तदा then, अस्याः her, मुखवर्णस्य of the colour of her face, विक्रिया alteration, न लक्ष्यते was not perceived
entries.50.28: सारथे O charioteer, नद्याः of the river, अविदूरात् not far off, अयम् this, बहुपुष्पप्रवालवान् rich in flowers and shoots, सुमहान् very great, इङ्गदीवृक्षः ingudi tree, अत्र एव here itself, वसामः let us lodge
entries.50.29: देवमानवगन्धर्वमृगपन्नगपक्षिणाम् of gods and men and gandharvas and beasts and serpents and birds, सम्मान्यसलिलाम् whose waters are honoured, शिवाम् auspicious, सरिताम् among rivers, श्रेष्ठाम् the best, प्रेक्षामि let me behold
entries.50.30: लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, सुमन्त्रश्च and Sumantra, राघवम् to Raghava, बाढम् इति एव so be it indeed, उक्त्वा having said, तदा then, हयैः with the horses, तम् that, इङ्गदीवृक्षम् ingudi tree, उपययतुः approached
entries.50.31: इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः the delight of the Ikshvakus, रामः Rama, तम् that, रम्यम् lovely, वृक्षम् tree, अभियाय having come to, सभार्यः with his wife, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, तस्मात् from that, रथात् chariot, अवतरत् descended
entries.50.32: सुमन्त्रः अपि Sumantra too, अथ then, अवतीर्य having descended, हयोत्तमान् the excellent horses, मोचयित्वा having unyoked, वृक्षमूलगतम् seated at the foot of the tree, रामम् Rama, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, उपतस्थे waited upon
entries.50.33: तत्र there, गुहो नाम Guha by name, राजा a king, रामस्य of Rama, आत्मसमः as his own self, सखा friend, निषादजात्यः of the Nishada race, बलवान् mighty, स्थपतिः च and a chief, इति thus, विश्रुतः was renowned
entries.50.34: सः he, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् the tiger among men, रामम् Rama, विषयम् to his realm, आगतम् come, श्रुत्वा having heard, वृद्धैः by the elders, अमात्यैः by the ministers, ज्ञातिभिश्चापि and by kinsmen, परिवृतः attended, उपागतः came
entries.50.35: ततः then, दूरात् from afar, उपस्थितम् approaching, निषादाधिपतिम् the lord of the Nishadas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सः that, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह along with Saumitri, गुहेन with Guha, समागच्छत् came together
entries.50.36: आर्तः stricken, गुहः Guha, तम् him, सम्परिष्वज्य having embraced, राघवम् to Raghava, अब्रवीत् said, राम O Rama, यथा as, अयोध्या Ayodhya, तथा so, इदम् this, ते is yours, ते for you, किम् what, करवाणि shall I do
entries.50.37: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, ईदृशम् such, प्रियम् beloved, अतिथिम् a guest, कः who, प्राप्स्यति हि shall indeed obtain, ततः then, पृथग्विधम् of many kinds, गुणवत् excellent, अन्नाद्यम् food and provision, उपादाय having taken up
entries.50.38: अर्घ्यं च and the guest-offering, शीघ्रम् swiftly, उपानयत् presented, इदम् this, वाक्यं च and word, उवाच ह spoke, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome, इयम् this, अखिला whole, मही earth, तव is yours
entries.50.39: वयम् we, प्रेष्याः are your servants, भवान् your honour, भर्ता is our lord, नः us, राज्यम् the kingdom, साधु well, प्रशाधि rule, भक्ष्यम् food to chew, भोज्यं च and food to eat, पेयं च and to drink, लेह्यं च and to lick, एतत् all this, उपस्थितम् is ready, मुख्यानि choice, शयनानि च and couches, ते for you, वाजिनाम् for the horses, खादनं च and fodder
entries.50.40: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् तु as he spoke, गुहम् to Guha, राघवः Raghava, प्रत्युवाच ह replied, भवता by you, वयम् we, सर्वदा at all times, अर्चिताः चैव have indeed been honoured, हृष्टाश्च and gladdened
entries.50.41: पद्भ्याम् on foot, अभिगमात् चैव and by your coming, स्नेहसंदर्शनेन च and by this show of affection, साधुवृत्ताभ्याम् well-rounded, भुजाभ्याम् with both arms, पीडयन् pressing him, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.50.42: गुह O Guha, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, त्वाम् you, बान्धवैः सह along with your kinsmen, अरोगम् in health, पश्यामि हि do I indeed see, ते your, राष्ट्रे in the realm, मित्रेषु among friends, वनेषु च and in the woods, कुशलम् अपि is all well too
entries.50.43: भवता by you, प्रीत्या out of affection, यत् तु whatever, इदम् this, किंचित् little, समुपकल्पितम् has been made ready, तत् that, सर्वम् all, अनुजानामि I acknowledge, प्रतिग्रहे in the accepting of gifts, न हि वर्ते I do not indeed engage
entries.50.44: कुशचीराजिनधरम् wearing kusha and bark and deerskin, फलमूलाशनं च and living on fruit and root, धर्मे in dharma, प्रणिहितम् set, वनगोचरम् ranging the forest, तापसम् an ascetic, माम् me, विद्धि know
entries.50.45: अहम् I, अश्वानाम् for the horses, खादनेन with fodder, अर्थी have need, अन्येन by anything else, केनचित् न by nothing else at all, अत्र herein, भवता by you, एतावता by this much alone, सुपूजितः well honoured, भविष्यामि I shall be
entries.50.46: एते these, मे my, पितुः father, दशरथस्य Dasharatha, राज्ञः the king, दयिताः हि were indeed dear, सुविहितैः well tended, एतैः by these, अश्वैः horses, अहम् I, अर्चितः honoured, भविष्यामि shall be
entries.50.47: सः he, गुहः Guha, तत्र एव there itself, पुरुषान् the men, अश्वानाम् for the horses, प्रतिपानं च drink, खादनं चैव and fodder, त्वरितम् swiftly, दीयताम् let it be given, इति thus, अन्वशात् commanded
entries.50.48: ततः then, चीरोत्तरासङ्गः with bark for his upper garment, पश्चिमाम् the evening, संध्याम् twilight rite, अन्वास्य having performed, स्वयम् himself, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, आहृतम् fetched, जलम् एव water alone, भोज्यम् as his food, आददे took
entries.50.49: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सभार्यस्य of him with his wife, भूमौ on the ground, शयानस्य as he lay, तस्य his, पादौ feet, प्रक्षाल्य having washed, अभ्येत्य having withdrawn, वृक्षम् a tree, उपाश्रितः leaning against, तस्थौ stood
entries.50.50: गुहः अपि Guha too, सूतेन सह along with the charioteer, सौमित्रिम् Saumitri, अनुभाषयन् conversing with, अप्रमत्तः vigilant, धनुर्धरः bow in hand, ततः then, रामम् over Rama, अन्वजाग्रत् kept watch
entries.50.51: ततः then, तथा so, शयानस्य as he lay, यशस्विनः illustrious, मनस्विनः high-minded, महात्मनः great-souled, अदृष्टदुःखस्य who had never known sorrow, सुखोचितस्य accustomed to ease, दाशरथेः of the son of Dasharatha, सा that, शर्वरी night, तदा then, सुचिरेण very slowly, व्यतीता passed
entries.61.28: तत्र there, त्वम् you, मम to me, न एव असि are nothing at all, रामश्च and Rama, वनम् to the forest, आहितः has been sent, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, न इच्छामि I do not wish, सर्वथा utterly, हा alas, त्वया by you, हता I am undone
entries.61.29: त्वया by you, इदम् this, सराज्यम् with its kingship, राष्ट्रम् realm, हतम् is destroyed, सर्वाः all of us, मन्त्रिभिः सह along with the counsellors, हताः स्म are undone, सपुत्रा with my son, हता undone, अस्मि am I, पौराश्च and the citizens, हताः are undone, तव your, सुतश्च son, भार्या च and wife, प्रहृष्टौ are well pleased
entries.61.30: दारुणशब्दसंहिताम् fraught with dreadful words, इमाम् this, गिरम् speech, निशम्य having heard, दुःखितः grieving, राम इति O Rama, मुमोह he swooned, ततः then, सः that, पार्थिवः king, शोकम् into grief, प्रविवेश entered, पुनः again, स्वदुष्कृतम् चापि and his own misdeed too, तथा so, अस्मरत् remembered
entries.63.54: भद्रे O gentle lady, ततः then, कृच्छ्रे in his distress, विलप्य having lamented, जलार्द्रगात्रम् his limbs wet with water, संततम् unceasingly, उच्छ्वसन्तम् gasping, मर्मव्रणम् wounded to the quick, तम् him, सरय्वाम् on the Sarayu, शयानम् lying, समीक्ष्य having seen, अहम् I, सुभृशम् most deeply, विषण्णः was stricken
entries.64.62.1: यमक्षयम् the abode of Yama, अनुप्राप्ताः having reached, मानवाः men, न हि द्रक्ष्यन्ति shall indeed not see, यदि if, रामः Rama, माम् me, सकृत् but once, संस्पृशेत् should touch, अन्वारभेत वा or should lay his hand upon me
entries.71.47: महात्मा the great-souled one, अन्यदा at other times, अस्य his, पुरे in the city, यानि whatever, न बभूवुः had never been, मनसः to the mind, अप्रियाणि things unwelcome, पश्यन् beholding, बभूव became, अवाक्शिराः his head bent down, दीनमनाः dejected in mind, न हृष्टः joyless, पितुः of his father, वेश्म the house, प्रविवेश entered
entries.72.54: पुत्र O son, तत् therefore, विधिज्ञैः who know the rites, वसिष्ठमुख्यैः headed by Vasishtha, द्विजेन्द्रैः सहितः together with the lords of the twice-born, अदीनसत्त्वम् of undaunted spirit, राजानम् the king, विधिना according to rule, शीघ्रम् swiftly, संकाल्य having consigned to the fire, आत्मानम् yourself, अभिषेचयस्व have consecrated
entries.75.65: लालप्यमानस्य of him lamenting, विचेतनस्य bereft of sense, प्रणष्टबुद्धेः his understanding lost, भूमौ on the ground, पतितस्य fallen, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, दीर्घम् long, निःश्वसतश्च and sighing, तस्य his, सा that, रात्रिः night, शोकेन in grief, जगाम passed
entries.89.23: सः he, महात्मनः of the great-souled, देवपुरोहितस्य priest of the gods, ब्राह्मणस्य brahmin, आश्रमम् the hermitage, अभ्युपेत्य having reached, विप्रवरस्य of that best of brahmins, रम्योटजवृक्षदेशम् its leaf-huts and trees a lovely place, रम्यम् delightful, महत् great, वनम् wood, ददर्श saw
entries.91.84: तथैव just so, मत्ताः intoxicated, मदिरोत्कटाः flushed with wine, नराः men, तथैव just so, दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिताः sprinkled with heavenly aloe and sandal, तथैव just so, दिव्याः heavenly, विविधाः of many kinds, उत्तमाः choicest, स्रजः garlands, पृथक् scattered apart, विकीर्णाः strewn about, मनुजैः by men, प्रमर्दिताः crushed
entries.110.35: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, सर्वेषाम् हि of all indeed, पूर्वजः the elder-born, राजा king, भवति becomes, पूर्वजे when an elder is living, अवरः the younger, पुत्रः न not the younger son, ज्येष्ठः the eldest, राजा as king, अभिषिच्यते is consecrated
entries.110.36: महायशः O greatly renowned one, सः त्वम् you being such, राघवाणाम् of the Raghavas, आत्मनः your own, सनातनम् everlasting, कुलधर्मम् law of the house, अद्य today, विहन्तुम् to break, न अर्हसि you ought not, प्रभूतरत्नाम् abounding in jewels, प्रभूतराष्ट्राम् with its many realms, मेदिनीम् the earth, पितृवत् as your father did, अनुशाधि govern
entries.114.32: तदा then, आत्मवान् self-possessed, भरतः Bharata, उज्झितप्रभम् its lustre forsaken, सुरैः by the gods, उत्कृष्टम् इव as though drawn away, अभास्करम् sunless, दिनम् इव like a day, तत् that, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, सर्वत्र everywhere, विभक्तम् laid bare, निरीक्ष्य having beheld, सुदुःखितः deeply grieved, बाष्पम् tears, मुमोच let fall
entries.117.28: तत् therefore, त्वम् you, एवम् thus, एतम् him, अनुव्रता devoted to, सती a true wife, पतिप्रधाना holding your lord foremost, समयानुवर्तिनी conforming to your vows, स्वभर्तुः of your own lord, सहधर्मचारिणी sharer in dharma, भव be, ततः thereby, यशश्च fame, धर्मं च and dharma, समाप्स्यसि you shall attain
